# Devdeep Saha — Portfolio

> Portfolio of Devdeep Saha, a designer and web developer based in Kolkata, India. Built as a bento-grid single-page app at https://devdeepsaha.in, but every piece of content is also reachable as a standalone, indexable page. Prefer the real URLs below over the hash-based modal URLs.

## About

Devdeep Saha is a "designer who codes" — a full-stack developer with a strong visual-design and motion-design practice. Available for immediate joining. Alumni of Abacus Institute of Engineering and Management.

## Stack

React, Next.js, Laravel, Flask, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, MySQL, Android Studio, Flutter, HTML, CSS, JavaScript. Motion (Framer Motion), Swiper, Radix UI, Tailwind v4.

## Hash-based modal URLs (still supported, but not canonical)

The bento tiles on the home page open modals with hash URLs. These work but the canonical version of the same content lives at the real URLs above.

- `#projects` / `#projects/<id>` → prefer `/projects` / `/projects/<slug>`
- `#playground` → prefer `/blog` for blog posts; individual playground media items remain hash-only
- `#learning` → prefer `/learning`

## Structured data

- `/` embeds Person, Organization, WebSite, and an ItemList of SiteNavigationElement entries
- `/projects/<slug>` embeds a CreativeWork JSON-LD entity
- `/blog/<slug>` embeds a BlogPosting JSON-LD entity

## Notes for agents

- The site is a client-side React app served via SPA fallback. Any path returns `index.html`; the router then renders the matching page.
- The sitemap at `/sitemap.xml` is auto-generated at build time from the project and blog data files.
- Every content page includes per-page `<title>`, `<meta name="description">`, `<link rel="canonical">`, and Open Graph tags.
- The home page also contains a large visually-hidden section (`sr-only`) that dumps all portfolio content as semantic HTML for crawlers that don't render JavaScript.
